title: DBCM: Dual-Branch Calibration Module for Test-Time Adaptation in Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.32071v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Non-stationarity induces test-time distribution shifts in time series forecasting (TSF), resulting in forecast residuals between predictions and the corresponding ground truth. Recent works on test-time adaptation for TSF address this by introducing lightweight calibration modules around frozen forecasters, updated using observations that become incrementally available at test time. Existing approaches typically employ channel-wise adapters, implicitly assuming that forecast residuals are inherently channel-specific. However, we observe that forecast residuals often exhibit substantial shared structure across channels, suggesting that fully independent channel-wise parameterization may be redundant. translated_title: DBCM：用于时间序列预测测试时适应的双分支校准模块
translated_abstract: 非平稳性会在时间序列预测（TSF）中引发测试时的分布偏移，导致预测结果与相应真实值之间产生预测残差。近期关于时间序列预测测试时适应的工作通过在冻结的预测器周围引入轻量级校准模块来解决这一问题，这些模块利用测试时逐步获得的观测数据进行更新。现有方法通常采用逐通道适配器，隐含地假设预测残差本质上是通道特定的。然而，我们观察到预测残差在通道之间往往表现出大量的共享结构，这表明完全独立的逐通道参数化可能是冗余的。受此观察启发，我们提出了双分支校准模块（DBCM），它通过共享适配器在通道之间共享适应能力，同时通过低秩通道分支保留有限的通道特定灵活性。
tldr: 提出双分支校准模块DBCM，通过共享适配器利用跨通道预测残差的共享结构，并结合低秩通道分支保留有限的通道特定灵活性，实现时间序列预测中更高效的测试时适应。
en_tdlr: DBCM is a dual-branch calibration module for test-time adaptation in time series forecasting that shares adaptation capacity across channels via a shared adapter while retaining limited channel-specific flexibility through a low-rank branch.
